verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a work-management platform. The evidence only documents single-item API task creation, pagination for reads, rules, webhooks and natural-language MCP task management. Nothing describes a batch endpoint, multi-select bulk edit, or applying one change across many items at once. Third-party integrations such as Zapier and n8n are external workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
